scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w shared && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run build -w shared && playwright test --ui
